sections.title: How it works
sections.content: You know *mindazonáltal* from B2 Unit 16 and *ezzel szemben* from B1 Unit 11. New in this lesson: the postposition `szemben` with a noun in -val/-vel (`a másolattal szemben` as against the copy, `a díszletekkel szemben`) and the vocabulary of the debate on pastiche.

sections.title: Example
sections.content: Example: `A homlokzat szép, mindazonáltal nem hiteles.`

sections.title: Patterns in Context
rows: A másolattal szemben az eredeti kő a kor tanúja.
As against the copy, the original stone is a witness of its time.
A díszletekkel szemben a romok hitelesek.
As against stage sets, ruins are authentic.
A homlokzat szép, mindazonáltal nem hiteles.
The facade is beautiful; nevertheless it is not authentic.
